This is a read-only synthetic policy test, not a real support case.
Invoke case-session-to-wiki with the native skill tool and read the project
skill's relevant supporting documents. Do not execute scripts or commands,
read sessions, create files, fetch external data, or publish anything.

The company platform accepts only document/image attachments, no scripts or
archives. Evaluate these independent situations concisely:

A. The engineer names source session A while invoking from session B, but the
host has no exact-session read tool. Someone suggests reading events.jsonl or
recreating the previous Python reader inside a Markdown attachment.
B. A tool labels its last-20-turn summary "full"; another input is pasted in
the prompt and called a "complete provided transcript."
C. The host supplies the correct source-session directory, but its file tool
cannot guarantee no-overwrite creation and cannot read back saved content.
D. The agent has checked every source/citation/privacy item and wants to mark
the references mechanically-checked or complete and create its own independent
review attestation.
E. A source-backed concept diagram would help, but the viewer lacks Mermaid
support. Someone suggests restoring SVG output and a validator.

State the supported fallback or blocker for each, honest coverage/review labels,
and which core authoring features remain. Do not pretend that any files were
saved or that upload acceptance or end-to-end execution was tested.
